compatibility_badge: PCB Layout Change Required (Pinout or Package Mismatch)

pin_diff.note: PINOUT CONFLICT on Pin 1: AP7365-33YG-13 assigns OUT (VOUT) whereas LM1117IMPX-3.3/NOPB assigns ADJ/GND (GND) — direct drop-in risks rail short or IC destruction.
PINOUT CONFLICT on Pin 2: AP7365-33YG-13 assigns GND (GND) whereas LM1117IMPX-3.3/NOPB assigns VOUT (VOUT) — direct drop-in risks rail short or IC destruction.
Functionally identical VIN pin (IN vs VIN).

parameter_matrix.note: Check PCB land pattern & height profile.
A part wins only if its operating Vin range strictly encompasses the counterpart on both ends.
Higher Vin,abs improves survivability against hot-plug and inductive bus spikes.
Tighter Vout tolerance improves ADC reference and digital rail margin.
Actual usable continuous Iout is also bounded by package θJA thermal derating.
Lower Iq directly extends sleep-mode battery life in always-on IoT/portable rails.
Lower dropout allows regulation deeper into Li-ion / 3.7 V discharge curves.

parameter_matrix.part_a_value: Ceramic OK · >=1 µF · Low-ESR MLCC compatible
parameter_matrix.note: Non-ceramic-stable LDOs oscillate with low-ESR MLCCs unless series resistance or tantalum is used.
Higher PSRR attenuates upstream switching-converter ripple on analog/RF rails.
Critical for RF VCOs, low-noise ADCs, and precision sensor excitation.
Lower θJA yields lower junction temperature rise ΔTj = (Vin - Vout) × Iout × θJA.
Keep steady-state Tj at least 15–25 °C below Tj,max for production reliability.

swap_risks: CRITICAL PACKAGE MISMATCH: AP7365-33YG-13 uses SOT-89-3 (3-pin, Y (SOT89)) while LM1117IMPX-3.3/NOPB uses SOT-223-3 (3-pin, DCY); PCB footprint redesign is mandatory.

CRITICAL PINOUT CONFLICT: Incompatible pin assignments on Pin 1 (VOUT vs GND), Pin 2 (GND vs VOUT). Soldering LM1117IMPX-3.3/NOPB onto a AP7365-33YG-13 footprint (or vice versa) without rerouting copper can short VIN/VOUT/GND and permanently damage the board.
CRITICAL SHORT-CIRCUIT HAZARD: Exposed thermal pad/tab net conflict (GND vs VOUT) — direct swap will short power rails.

CRITICAL CAPACITOR ESR OSCILLATION RISK: AP7365-33YG-13 is stable with low-ESR ceramic MLCCs (>= 1 µF, p.1), whereas LM1117IMPX-3.3/NOPB is NOT ceramic-cap stable (ESR window: 0.3–22 Ω (p.15)). Using an ultra-low-ESR MLCC on LM1117IMPX-3.3/NOPB can trigger control-loop oscillation.
CAUTION OUTPUT CAPACITANCE: Minimum Cout differs by 10x (AP7365-33YG-13: 1 µF p.1 vs LM1117IMPX-3.3/NOPB: 10 µF p.15); account for MLCC DC-bias derating.
HIGH INPUT VOLTAGE RATING DROP: AP7365-33YG-13 is rated to only 6 V rec. (6.5 V abs max, p.3) vs LM1117IMPX-3.3/NOPB at 15 V rec. (20 V abs max, p.4). Verify worst-case input transient spikes.
HIGH LOAD CURRENT DERATING: AP7365-33YG-13 supplies up to 600 mA (p.3) compared to LM1117IMPX-3.3/NOPB at 800 mA (p.7); confirm peak inrush and thermal dissipation margin.
CAUTION DROPOUT HEADROOM: Typical dropout differs (AP7365-33YG-13: 300 mV p.3 vs LM1117IMPX-3.3/NOPB: 1200 mV p.8); verify Vin,min - Vout >= Vdo across temperature and load corners.

HIGH ABSOLUTE-MAX SURGE MARGIN: AP7365-33YG-13 has a lower Vin,abs,max rating (6.5 V, p.3) than LM1117IMPX-3.3/NOPB (20 V, p.4); verify hot-plug, inductive kickback, and TVS clamp peaks stay safely below 6.5 V.
HIGH THERMAL MARGIN: Package θJA is 116% higher on AP7365-33YG-13 (AP7365-33YG-13: 133 °C/W p.4 vs LM1117IMPX-3.3/NOPB: 61.6 °C/W p.4); re-check Tj = Ta + Pd × θJA against Tj,max.
HIGH MINIMUM SUPPLY FLOOR: LM1117IMPX-3.3/NOPB requires Vin,min >= 4.75 V (p.7) vs 2 V on the counterpart; confirm low-battery / brown-out operation still clears the higher floor.

HIGH TEMPERATURE GRADE MISMATCH: Rated ambient range differs (AP7365-33YG-13: -40..85 °C Industrial (-40°C to +85°C TA; TJ max +150°C, TSD +145°C) vs LM1117IMPX-3.3/NOPB: -40..125 °C Industrial (-40°C to +125°C TJ, LM1117I grade)); AP7365-33YG-13 hot limit only 85 °C — verify product ambient qualification before swapping.
CAUTION LIFECYCLE STATUS (NRND): AP7365-33YG-13 is flagged NRND by Diodes Incorporated; do not design into new production layouts — evaluate Active alternatives.
engineering_verdict: AP7365-33YG-13 (Diodes Incorporated, SOT-89-3) and LM1117IMPX-3.3/NOPB (Texas Instruments, SOT-223-3) are NOT drop-in interchangeable (Level 3 PCB Layout / Circuit Change Required) due to package/footprint mismatch; pinout mismatch on Pin 1 (VOUT vs GND), Pin 2 (GND vs VOUT); exposed pad / thermal tab net mismatch. Specific pin conflicts: Pin 1 (VOUT vs GND), Pin 2 (GND vs VOUT). Under a representative 5 V → 3.3 V rail at 150 mA (255 mW), estimated self-heating is ΔTj ≈ 33.9 °C on AP7365-33YG-13 (θJA 133 °C/W) vs 15.7 °C on LM1117IMPX-3.3/NOPB (θJA 61.6 °C/W), while quiescent draw spans a 142.9x ratio (35 µA (p.3) vs 5000 µA (p.8)). Primary bench gotchas to watch: AP7365-33YG-13 "NRND Lifecycle Banner on Page 1 — Diodes Inc Directs New Designs to AP7366" (p.1) and LM1117IMPX-3.3/NOPB "Strict 0.3–22 Ohm ESR Window — Unstable With Direct MLCC Ceramic Output Capacitors" (p.15). BOM decision: Choose AP7365-33YG-13 when battery sleep budget demands 35 µA Iq or your BOM standardizes on low-ESR MLCC ceramic output capacitors; choose LM1117IMPX-3.3/NOPB when load current exceeds 600 mA (up to 800 mA) or input rails climb above 6 V (rated to 15 V). Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.1 vs TOP_VIEW p.3) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
